typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		labor_agreement_key as short,
		reg_temp_key as integer,
		department_site_key as integer,
		reports_to_job_key as integer,
		company_key as short,
		as_of_date_key as integer,
		head_count as integer,
		job_code_key as integer,
		business_unit_key as short,
		job_key as integer,
		full_part_time_key as integer,
		employee_key as integer,
		years_in_job as integer,
		job_count as integer,
		union_key as integer,
		fte as integer,
		hourly_rt as integer,
		department_key as integer,
		employee_status_key as integer,
		hscis_classification_key as short,
		age as integer,
		location_key as short
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: '/*             */ select JS.job_key,        JS.company_key,        JS.full_part_time_key,        JS.reg_temp_key,        JS.employee_status_key,        JS.union_key,        JS.employee_key,        JS.as_of_date_key,        JS.fte,        JS.age,        JS.years_in_job,        JS.hourly_rt,  case when (Rank()OVER (PARTITION BY emplid, [date] ORDER BY emplid, fte DESC,empl_status_order, full_part_time_order,job_indicator_order,  hourly_rt DESC, empl_rcd ASC, effective_from)) <> 1 then 0 else 1 end as head_count, JS.labor_agreement_key, JS.hscis_classification_key, JS.business_unit_key, JS.location_key, JS.job_code_key, JS.department_key, cast (1 as int) as job_count, JS.department_site_key, JS.reports_to_job_key   from  (SELECT J.job_key,        J.full_part_time_key,        J.employment_type_key AS reg_temp_key,        J.employee_status_key,        J.union_key,        J.company_key,        J.employee_key,        J.hire_date,        J.termination_date,        J.effective_from,                      DATEDIFF(DAY, E.birthdate, case when D.[date]<isnull(J.termination_date,\'2099-01-01\') then D.date else J.termination_date end)/365.25 AS age,                                    DATEDIFF(DAY, J.hire_date, case when D.[date]<isnull(J.termination_date,\'2099-01-01\') then D.date else J.termination_date end)/365.25 AS years_in_job,        d.date_key            AS as_of_date_key,        d.date,        J.fte,        J.company,        J.emplid,        J.empl_rcd,        J.business_unit,        J.empl_ctg_l2,        J.next_job_key,        J.previous_job_key,        J.deptid,        J.std_hours,        J.hourly_rt,                CASE J.employment_status              when \'A\' THEN 0              when \'L\' then 1              when \'P\' then 2              when \'S\' then 3              ELSE 10        END                                                                        AS empl_status_order,       J.job_indicator,    CASE 		 WHEN J.job_indicator = \'P\' THEN 0 		 ELSE 1    END                                                                        AS job_indicator_order, 	Case J.full_part_time 		when \'F\' then 1 		when \'P\' then 2 		when \'C\' then 3 		else 4 	end																	as full_part_time_order, 	J.labor_agreement_key, 	J.hscis_classification_key, 	J.business_unit_key, 	J.location_key, 	J.job_code_key, 	J.department_key, J.department_site_key, J.reports_to_job_key                FROM   hr.dim_job J  						left outer join hr.dim_employee E 		on J.employee_key = E.employee_key		  		,               (SELECT Max(date_key) AS date_key,                Max(DATE)     AS [date]         FROM   [shared].[dim_date]         WHERE  DATE BETWEEN \'2006-01-01\' AND Getdate()         GROUP  BY [Year],                   [month]         UNION         SELECT Max(date_key) AS date_key,                Max(DATE)     AS [date]         FROM   [shared].[dim_date]         WHERE  DATE BETWEEN \'2006-01-01\' AND Getdate()         GROUP  BY fiscal_year,                   fiscal_period)  d  WHERE  J.effective_from = (SELECT Max(effective_from)                            FROM   hr.dim_job                            WHERE  effective_from <= d.DATE                                   AND emplid = J.emplid                                   AND empl_rcd = J.empl_rcd)        AND effseq = (SELECT Max(effseq)                      FROM   hr.dim_job                      WHERE  effective_from = J.effective_from                             AND emplid = J.emplid                             AND empl_rcd = J.empl_rcd)                             and J.employment_status in (\'A\',\'L\',\'P\',\'S\')                                                                                                          ) JS',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		labor_agreement_key as short,
		reg_temp_key as short,
		department_site_key as integer,
		reports_to_job_key as integer,
		company_key as short,
		as_of_date_key as integer,
		head_count as long,
		job_code_key as integer,
		business_unit_key as integer,
		job_key as integer,
		full_part_time_key as short,
		employee_key as integer,
		years_in_job as integer,
		job_count as long,
		union_key as short,
		fte as integer,
		hourly_rate as integer,
		department_key as integer,
		employee_status_key as short,
		hscis_classification_key as short,
		age as integer,
		location_key as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		labor_agreement_key,
		reg_temp_key,
		department_site_key,
		reports_to_job_key,
		company_key,
		as_of_date_key,
		head_count,
		job_code_key,
		business_unit_key,
		job_key,
		full_part_time_key,
		employee_key,
		years_in_job,
		job_count,
		union_key,
		fte,
		hourly_rate = hourly_rt,
		department_key,
		employee_status_key,
		hscis_classification_key,
		age,
		location_key),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
